summary: A clean local shop, not a motorsport brand: primer-white pages, graphite bands and deep blued-steel scrims behind the words
Amber is reserved for the call and quote pills on the real site, with dark text; this specimen draws buttons in the steel primary
Big condensed headings (Barlow Condensed) set straight onto images of blasted steel, cured surfaces and shop light
Openings run full-bleed behind a floating header; a sticky mobile bar keeps Call and Quote one tap away
Real CMB work photos replace generated material images once the owner authorises them; no generated parts, people or shop interiors
No numerals, no divider lines, no reviews or ratings until the owner authorises them
